description: This file defines a helper class ShareAccountHelper used in integration tests to construct JSON payloads for share account operations within the Fineract project. It provides methods to set various parameters and generate a JSON string representing a share account creation request.

classes.name: ShareAccountHelper
classes.description: Helper class for building share account creation JSON payloads in integration tests.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the share account creation request based on set parameters.

methods.name: withClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID parameter for the share account.

methods.name: withRequestedShares
methods.description: Sets the number of requested shares.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Sets the list of charges associated with the share account.
